en.title: What is archeris.net?
en.excerpt: A comprehensive introduction to Indonesia's first integrated archery management platform.
en.content:
About archeris.net

archeris.net is the first integrated archery digital ecosystem in Indonesia designed to connect all elements in the sport of archery — from athletes, clubs, event organizers, to equipment providers in one harmonious platform.

💡
Indonesian Archery Interaction Center
archeris.net is not just a management tool, but a digital home where the archery community grows, competes and transacts safely and transparently.

Platform Mission

We are here to digitize all operational processes in the world of archery, which are still mostly done manually. Our vision is to create a new standard in organizing events and managing athlete data that is professional, transparent and easily accessible to all levels of the community.

Main Features

  • Event & Tournament Management: Complete solution for registration, session sharing, and accurate results processing.
  • Digital Scoring System: Real-time score input connected directly to the public leaderboard, minimizing manual errors.
  • Marketplace & Equipment: Verified and trusted archery equipment buying and selling ecosystem.
  • Digital Athlete Portfolio: A neatly stored track record of achievements and performance statistics as an archer's professional identity.

For Whom?

archeris.net is designed to serve every important role in the Indonesian archery ecosystem. We understand that each actor has unique needs, so the platform provides highly specific and integrated features for each role.

For Athletes and Archers, the platform acts as a digital personal assistant. Apart from making event registration easy without hassle, our system records each of your scores and achievements automatically. This helps you build a professional identity (Digital Archer Profile) that can be accessed by sponsors, coaches and the wider community.

🏹 Athletes / Archers
Individual archers of any level can register for tournaments instantly, view national rankings, and track their long-term performance statistics.
🎖️ Organizer / Organization
Event organizers get an end-to-end solution: from registration management, schedule management, to a systematic real-time digital scoring system.
🛒 Equipment Shop & Seller
Archery equipment business players can reach specific and verified target markets directly within the ecosystem of archery enthusiasts.
👨‍👩‍👧 Parents & Companions
Makes it easy for families to monitor match schedules and the development of achievements of coached athletes in a transparent and measurable manner.

Apart from the three main pillars above, this platform is also very useful for Trainers and Coaches. With accurate statistical data from each event they participate in, coaches can carry out objective analysis of their athletes' performance without having to rely on scattered manual records. archeris.net helps summarize athletes' shooting patterns and scoring consistency over time.

We continue to be committed to expanding the reach of this platform to accommodate more scenarios in the field, ensuring that every small piece of progress achieved by an archer is recorded and appreciated in Indonesia's growing digital archery ecosystem.
